dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 15, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Thrilling Wins and Dominant Performances**

The MLB saw several exciting games yesterday, with multiple teams emerging victorious in thrilling fashion. In the American League, the Seattle Mariners came out on top against the Houston Astros, with Emerson Hancock delivering a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs. Hancock earned the win as the Mariners won 10-5. In another AL game, the Baltimore Orioles edged out the Tampa Bay Rays 4-3, thanks in part to Ian Seymour's 6.0 innings of work, where he struck out 9 batters.

In the National League, the Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Minnesota Twins 9-1, with Jesús Luzardo pitching 6.2 innings, fanning 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. Luzardo earned the win as the Phillies cruised to victory. The Arizona Diamondbacks also had a big win, defeating the Atlanta Braves 10-3, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 6.0 innings, striking out 5 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

In other games, the Chicago White Sox edged out the Detroit Tigers 4-3, with Jordan Hicks earning the win in relief. The St. Louis Cardinals beat the Chicago Cubs 8-4, thanks in part to Michael McGreevy's 6.0 innings of work, where he struck out 6 batters. The San Francisco Giants also had a big win, defeating the Colorado Rockies 7-1, with Logan Webb pitching 6.0 innings, striking out 7 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.
